environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in internal cluster. The deploy-plugin pod runs behind a ClusterIP Service exposed via an nginx Ingress controller with TLS termination (server-side only). The Ingress has annotation `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"` but no client certificate verification. Any pod in the cluster or any client with network access to the ingress can POST to /api/v1/deploy. The WEBHOOK_SECRET is set but an attacker who compromises any adjacent service can read it from the shared ConfigMap (deploy-config) mounted in the namespace.

config.kubernetes_ingress: nginx ingress with TLS termination, no auth-tls annotations
config.webhook_secret_storage: ConfigMap readable by all pods in namespace
